'''Jalindi''' was a [[planet]] located in the [[Jalindi system]]<ref name="ITNOTR" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Timelines" /> with a landscape of [[Color|red]] [[Stone|rock]] pillars surrounded by [[Water|mist]] amidst an [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s.<ref name="ITNOTR" /> Around [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note">The trivia guide for ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore]]'' states that [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] was redesigned to advance the character's age by "18 [[Standard year|years]] or so". As she was last seen was in ''[[The Lawless]]'', which was dated to [[19 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', it can be assumed that the events of ''Heroes of Mandalore'' take place in approximately [[1 BBY]]. As [[In the Name of the Rebellion]] takes place shortly after ''Heroes of Mandalore'', it can be assumed it is also around the [[Standard year|year]] 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire]] had a [[Jalindi Station|relay station]] there which was destroyed during a [[Mission to Jalindi|mission]] carried out by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], which had originally intended to only hack the relay.<ref name="ITNOTR" />
